title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, teach the gap picker to recognise a Class-1b measurement pr
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, teach the gap picker to recognise a Class-1b measurement predicate, so gaps that CAN measure their way out are no longer treated as unmeasurable and skipped forever.

ANCHOR. This exact line occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the file:
      || typeof m.evidence_resolve === 'string' || typeof m.verify_shape === 'string';

ONE OPERATION. Replace that single line with exactly:
      || typeof m.evidence_resolve === 'string' || typeof m.verify_shape === 'string'
      || typeof m.expected_literal === 'string';

Change nothing else. Do not touch the preceding `const hasMeasurablePredicate = typeof m.hardcoded_url === 'string'` line, the enclosing predicate, the top of the file, or any import.

WHY. That expression computes `hasMeasurablePredicate` inside the `isPending` callback the gap picker passes to `chooseFirstActionable`. It enumerates the predicate kinds a gap may carry — `hardcoded_url` (Class 1), `evidence_resolve` and `verify_shape` (Class 2) — but omits `expected_literal`, which is the Class-1b predicate. `verifyGapCondition` in this same file DOES honour `expected_literal`: it evaluates edit_site plus expected_literal against the deployed tree under /vessels with inverse polarity, so the literal being present means the defect is absent. The string `expected_literal` already appears six times in this file, so the concept is known here — it is only missing from this one enumeration.

CONSEQUENCE OF THE OMISSION. A gap that has been armed with a working Class-1b predicate still evaluates `hasMeasurablePredicate === false`, so `isPending` returns true and the picker skips it as unmeasurable. The gap can never be selected, and therefore can never land the change that would let its own predicate measure it resolved. It is a closed loop that arming the predicate was supposed to open.

MEASURED IMPACT. The compose lane has produced ZERO executions across four consecutive 30-minute windows on an idle box (loadavg 3-8, zero compose-cap refusals, so this is not contention). Recent windows: 9 picks / 9 skipped / 0 composes, then 23 picks / 23 skipped / 0 composes. Every pick is discarded by this pending judgement. `chooseFirstActionable` scans at most PENDING_SCAN_MAX = 20 candidates and then deliberately fails open, returning a pending gap that the post-selection guard refuses — so widening what counts as measurable is what actually frees the lane.

THIS IS THE SAME OMISSION IN A SECOND PLACE. `classifyFalsifier` in repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts has the identical blind spot and stamps `falsifier:"none"` on gaps carrying `expected_literal`. That was filed separately. Fix only the picker here; do not modify substrate-gap.ts in this change.
